title: Compound Inequality
description: Graph bounded compound inequalities on a number line.
learningObjective: Students represent compound inequalities as interval segments with correct endpoint inclusion.

feedback.defaultCorrect: Correct. Your interval matches the compound inequality.
feedback.defaultIncorrect: Not yet. Check which endpoints are included.
feedback.defaultEncouragement: Tap one endpoint, drag a ray handle toward the interval, then tap the other endpoint to make the segment.

questions.prompt: Tap -2, drag the right ray handle, tap 5, then set -2 open.

choices.label: I need to revise my graph

hints: Tap -2 to place the first endpoint.
Drag the right arrow handle, then tap 5 to finish the segment.
-2 is not included. Tap that endpoint if it is closed.
questions.correctFeedback: The selected answer is correct. The graph score checks the interval.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Revise your interval endpoints before checking again.

questions.prompt: Tap -4, drag the right ray handle, tap 1, then set 1 open.

choices.label: I need to revise my graph

hints: Tap -4 to place the first endpoint.
Drag the right arrow handle, then tap 1 to finish the segment.
1 is not included. Tap that endpoint if it is closed.
